name: SWARM_REQUEST
description: Generic on-demand request: retransmit / resource (e.g. thumbnail) / force-confirm. Includes dedup/TTL metadata.

fields.name: boot_id
fields.desc: Random ID generated on process start, identifies sender instance.

fields.name: time_ms
fields.desc: Sender timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

fields.name: target_system
fields.desc: Target system ID this request is addressed to.

fields.name: subject_type
fields.desc: Subject discriminator: RETRANSMIT->wanted MsgType value; RESOURCE->resource kind (e.g. THUMBNAIL=1); FORCE_CONFIRM->unused (0).

fields.name: subject_id
fields.desc: Subject id: RESOURCE/FORCE_CONFIRM->POI/task id; RETRANSMIT->0 or a specific seq.
